items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: That's when I met Anthony Lanner.

ctx.x: in about the latter part of 18 or the beginning of 19. That's when I met Anthony Lanner. Where were these people from on this racket? Well, to tell you the truth, Yellow was from here. Whether Ladder was from here, I don't know.
